messages:
jonathan (SDK): Heads-up — planning a minor SDK release tomorrow 09:00 PT (v1.4.3). It'll remove the legacy --compat-mode flag and add an inline runbook section to the docs for oncall/release steps. Need docs + release ops ack. @maria @sam :rocket:

maria (Docs): Thanks. Is there a PR we can review for the runbook text and migration notes? Also we should call out the exact behavior change (default now matches hosted runtime). :eyes:

jonathan (SDK): PR: https://git.redwood.dev/redwood/sdk/pulls/412 (draft). Short migration snippet I put in the PR:```python
# old
client = RedwoodClient(compat_mode=True)
# new (default)
client = RedwoodClient()
```
Also updated compatibility matrix in the PR. The inline runbook will live under /docs/ops/inline-runbooks/sdk-release.md and will be embedded in the SDK changelog page.

oliver (DevEx): Quick note: add a small structured-output acceptance test to ensure response shape doesn't change when --compat-mode is dropped. We saw one customer edge-case last quarter. Can you add that to the PR?

jonathan (SDK): Yep — added a test in the PR: tests/test_structured_output.py with a tiny fixture.

sam (Release): Rollout plan proposed: canary 10% for 30m, then 50% for 15m, then 100% if no errors. If we see an error spike >=5% or latency +200ms P95, we rollback. Rollback command: `./release_tool rollback --tag v1.4.3` and fallback model variant is `redwood/compat-legacy:2025-11`.

qa-bot: all checks passing on main + compatibility-suite: ✅ (2026-03-24T02:34:10Z)

sam (Release): Scheduling deploy job now. ETA: 2026-03-25 09:00 PT. I put a calendar invite for release lead + docs owner + oncall.

maria (Docs): I'll review the runbook today. Two doc asks: 1) a short FAQ entry for customers who set compat_mode explicitly, 2) a visible banner on the changelog page about the flag removal and the migration snippet.

jonathan (SDK): Good call. I'll add the FAQ + banner copy in the PR. Banner draft: "Note: --compat-mode removed in v1.4.3. If you relied on compat_mode=True, see migration notes and fallback model."

oliver (DevEx): Suggestion: link the runbook to the oncall channel and add a one-click rollback playbook snippet (small code block) so support can act quickly.

jonathan (SDK): Added this snippet to the runbook:```bash
# quick rollback (release host)
./release_tool rollback --tag v1.4.3 || echo 'rollback failed, escalate to release@'
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by sam at 2278456800 (canary window starts).

maria (Docs): Reviewed and left line comments in the PR. Two tiny wording nits, and a clarification on the FAQ about telemetry.

sam (Release): OK to proceed on my side once docs sign-off and QA green. @qa-bot — can you re-run the compat suite after I flip the canary flag?

qa-bot: queued. I'll post results in this thread when done.

jonathan (SDK): Thanks everyone — tagging this thread as the coordination place for the rollout. If any oncall needs it, the inline runbook URL will be: https://docs.redwood.dev/ops/inline-runbooks/sdk-release.md :wave:

sam (Release): Final reminder — if anyone can't make the 09:00 PT window, ping me. We'll hold for 10 minutes before starting canary. :thumbsup:

jonathan (SDK): Thanks — I'll monitor telemetry during canary and post a short status update here.
